title: erp.validate-and-create-customer (queue: erp)
description: Input is customer-sync.v1.json. Idempotent on (tenantId, crmCustomerId): a duplicate or a later attempt returns the existing ERP customer with created=false. Validation failures raise a non-retryable ApplicationFailure of type 'ValidationFailed'; anything else is retried by the workflow.

erpCustomerId.description: ERP-owned id (e.g. ERP-9001). Never derived from the CRM id.
